articles.title: Video by Saudi-backed Yemeni forces said to show clashes with Houthis
articles.description: STORY: :: Given as near Al-Hazm, Yemen / Released September 9, 2026 :: Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces release footage said to show clashes with Houthi fighters :: Saudi-backed forces launched an offensive after the Houthis tried to advance on government positions Reuters could not independently verify the location and the date when the video was filmed. No earlier versions of the footage were found posted online before September 9. Fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis has escalated in recent months, raising fears of a return to broader conflict after a U.N.-brokered truce in 2022 largely halted years of war. In recent days, Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces have launched a multi-pronged offensive on Houthi-held areas after the group attempted to advance on government positions. The government says it aims to recapture all Houthi-held territory.
